 The “SERVAMP POP-UP SHOP in AMNIBUS STORE -white-,” featuring the manga “SERVAMP” by Tanaka Strike, is here!
 From November 13 to November 29, 2026, at the AMNIBUS STORE -white- on the 4th floor of Shibuya Moddy, merchandise featuring brand-new, original illustrations based on the “idol” theme will be available for pre-sale, and postcards (9 varieties total) will be distributed as purchase bonuses.
 Key Points of This Article 
・November 13–29, 2026, at Shibuya Moddy 4F at “AMNIBUS STORE -white-”
・Pre-release sale of brand-new, “idol”-themed merchandise illustrated by Strike Tanaka
・For every 2,000 yen (tax included) spent, receive one random purchase bonus postcard (9 varieties total)
・Purchase a box of glitter pin badges to receive a free 75mm glitter pin badge
・On the first day, November 13, entry will be by random draw
 The article continues after the following ads 
 List of SERVAMP Articles 
 Details on the “SERVAMP POP-UP SHOP at AMNIBUS STORE -white-”
 A pop-up shop for the manga “SERVAMP” by Strike Tanaka will be held from November 13 to November 29, 2026, at “AMNIBUS STORE -white-” on the 4th floor of Shibuya MODI in Tokyo.
 This event will feature a preview sale of numerous merchandise items featuring brand-new illustrations drawn by Strike Tanaka based on the “idol” concept. Admission is free.
 ©TanakaStrike
 Purchase Bonus: “Event Purchase Bonus Postcard”
 During the event period, for every 2,000 yen (tax included) spent on event-related merchandise, you will receive one randomly selected “Event Purchase Bonus Postcard” (9 varieties total).
 This offer applies only to purchases made at the venue; online purchases are not eligible. Receipts cannot be combined, and the offer ends when supplies run out.
 ©TanakaStrike
 BOX Purchase Bonus: “Idol Ver. 75mm Glitter Pin”
 The article continues after the following ads 
 Purchase one BOX of the “Tanaka Strike Original Illustration: Idol Ver. Trading Glitter Pin Badges,” and you’ll receive a 75mm glitter pin badge—which varies by retailer—on a first-come, first-served basis.
 At the event venue, AMNIBUS STORE -white-, the “Mr. Tanaka Strike Original Illustration: Mahiru & Sakuya Idol Ver. 75mm Glitter Pin—Event-Exclusive Bonus” will be available!
 ©TanakaStrike
 The online store “AMNIBUS” and Animate will offer the “Tanaka Strike Original Illustration: Licht & Lowres Idol Ver. 75mm Glitter Pin Badge—AMNIBUS & Animate Exclusive Bonus.” Pre-orders at Animate are scheduled to begin the day after the event ends.
 ©TanakaStrike
 Merchandise Available at the “SERVAMP POP-UP SHOP”
 A total of 9 items—including trading cards featuring newly drawn illustrations of the Idol Ver., acrylic stands, and posters—will be available for pre-release purchase at the venue. In addition, many items currently available on AMNIBUS are scheduled to be on sale.
 ©TanakaStrike

 Admission Procedures, Purchase Limits, and Online Sales
 Shuffle Lottery Admission on the First Day
 To alleviate crowding inside the store, a shuffle lottery admission system will be implemented on the first day, November 13. The gathering time for numbered ticket distribution is from 10:15 to 10: 20 at the storefront plaza on the 1st floor of Shibuya Moddy; distribution begins at 10:20. The first entry slot is scheduled to begin at 11:15, and the exact entry time will be announced around 10:50 via the official AMNIBUS STORE X account.
 Admission via numbered tickets operates on a strict 15-minute time slot system with complete turnover between each slot; each ticket allows for one entry and one transaction. Since admission is not on a first-come, first-served basis, arriving early does not give you an advantage. You cannot join the line before the designated meeting time or after distribution has begun, nor can you meet up with companions once the line has formed. Depending on circumstances, the system may switch to free admission during the event period.
 Purchase Limits and Online Sales
 Purchase limits are as follows: for trading goods, up to 3 boxes or the equivalent of 3 boxes per type per transaction; for open-box items, up to 3 items per type per transaction.
 Starting on the event’s opening day, pre-orders will also be available on the “AMNIBUS” e-commerce site. Animate plans to begin accepting pre-orders starting the day after the event ends. Please check the official website for details, as pre-orders for some items may not be available at a later date.
 Event Commemorative X Campaign
 To commemorate the event, follow both the official AMNIBUS X and AMNIBUS STORE X accounts and repost the designated post for a chance to win a “Complete Set of Event Bonus Postcards (9 varieties total)” in a random drawing. The campaign runs until November 29, 2026.

 Frequently Asked Questions About the “SERVAMP” POP-UP SHOP
 When and where is it being held?
 The event will be held from November 13 to November 29, 2026, at “AMNIBUS STORE -white-” on the 4th floor of Shibuya MODI. Hours of operation are 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and admission is free.
 Are there any purchase bonuses?
 For every 2,000 yen (tax included) spent on event-related merchandise, you will receive one random “Event Purchase Bonus Postcard” (9 varieties total). This offer applies only to purchases made at the venue and will end when supplies run out.
 What are the BOX purchase bonuses?
 When you purchase one BOX of “Tanaka Strike’s Original Illustration: Idol Ver. Trading Glitter Pin Badges,” you’ll receive a 75mm glitter pin featuring Mahiru & Sakuya at the venue, and a 75mm glitter pin featuring Licht & Lawless at AMNIBUS and Animate. Both are available on a first-come, first-served basis and will end when supplies run out.
 How do I enter?
 On the first day, November 13, admission will be by random lottery. Numbered tickets will be distributed to those who gather at the Shibuya Moddy 1F Storefront Plaza between 10:15 and 10:20. After that, admission may switch to first-come, first-served depending on the situation.
 Can I purchase items online?
 Pre-orders will be accepted on the e-commerce site “AMNIBUS” starting on the event’s opening day, and Animate is scheduled to begin accepting pre-orders the day after the event ends. Please note that some items may not be available for pre-order at a later date.
